news.title: Bitcoin and Ether bears get decimated amid 'squeeze-led' rally and Musk's X wants to pay creators in stablecoins: Crypto's week in 5 stories
news.summary: Bitcoin and crypto staged their strongest rally in months as Treasury intervention, regulatory moves and a historic short squeeze collided, while banks and technology companies pushed deeper into stablecoins.

news.title: Zcash jumps 48% to over $800 as Grayscale spot ETF push adds to ‘next bitcoin’ buzz
news.summary: ZEC traded above its January 2018 peak as futures volume hit billions of dollars and a Grayscale filing showed fresh progress toward converting its Zcash Trust into a spot ETF.

news.title: How a Treasury buyback tweak helped bitcoin surge 25% to nearly $80,000 in days
news.summary: Treasury buybacks are not QE, analysts said, but the move helped pull long-term yields off 19-year highs and triggered a record short squeeze in a market already leaning too bearish.

news.title: Crypto advocates join in suing Illinois over digital asset tax
news.summary: The Crypto Council for Innovation and the Blockchain Association added another lawsuit against the state for its recently approved 0.2% crypto tax.

news.title: Pass the Clarity Act
news.summary: Reopening a settled provision four weeks before a vote would sink the bill, argues Summer Mersinger, CEO of the Blockchain Association.

news.title: Ethena's ENA token surges 48%, but altcoin season will have to wait
news.summary: ENA is rallying on a $1 billion FalconX deal, while HYPE tests its record, though flat dominance shows this is no broad alt season.

news.title: Coldcard ships firmware after $114 million bitcoin theft; says AI helped catch more bugs
news.summary: Three weeks of review turned up problems unrelated to the flaw that cost users $114 million, but updating still does not make a compromised wallet safe.

news.title: Analysts split on whether Bitcoin's surge past key levels signals a new bull run
news.summary: Market watchers say sudden sharp price spikes and forced short liquidations are the classic signs of a bottom, though macro risks still remain.

news.title: Our 4-year-old son has $100,000 in his 529 account. Is a bull market a bad time to buy him stocks instead?
news.summary: “I’d love for our son to be able to attend college without needing to take out student loans.”

news.title: Why an announcement from the Treasury sparked a rally in gold and bitcoin this week
news.summary: Cryptocurrencies and precious metals shot higher, while the U.S. dollar weakened, after the Treasury Department said it planned to double its bond buybacks.

news.title: Move over, credit cards: Social-media stars are tapping magic wands to buy things
news.summary: Tap-to-pay is getting a TikTok makeover as shoppers turn checking out into a personalized accessory.

news.title: ‘We are committed Christians’: Our son and daughter-in-law cut us out of their lives after a political argument. Should we change our $3 million will?
news.summary: “We are hurt and confused, but we have also tried to respect the boundaries they have established.”

news.title: ‘There is considerable tension’: My grandmother, 99, wants to cut my mother out of her will. Should I intervene?
news.summary: “Grandma feels that she was pressured by my mother into taking out a $50,000 HELOC.”

news.title: Here’s some surprisingly good news for the stock market this midterm election year
news.summary: There is a strong historical pattern of postmidterm strength.

news.title: ‘The estrangement isn’t about politics’: My daughter hasn’t spoken to me for 4 years. Do I leave her a monthly annuity?
news.summary: “You’ll have to trust me when I tell you that she had love, support and opportunities.”
